name: Tree of Knowledge International Corp.
summary: Tree of Knowledge International Corp. produces and sells hemp-based cannabidiol (CBD) products. The company offers industrial hemp-derived CBD oil, airless metered pens, capsules, drops, balms, creams, and tinctures. It also operates multidisciplinary specialty pain clinics, which focuses on the treatment of chronic pain, including controlled assessment, authorization, and monitoring of medical cannabis therapy; and develops products for therapeutic purposes, and wellness and natural health product alternatives. In addition, the company distributes and sells hemp-based cannabidiol products. It has a research agreement with the Ryerson University for medical cannabis research and new medical grade products development. The company has operations in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Brazil. Tree of Knowledge International Corp. is based in Toronto, Canada.
